content: Yesus po ayao kakaije muno anave raura

Yesus po raura Apa arakovo utavondi aije mai pare, “Tugae, anakotaro mo vatane maponae ti wo ayao kakaije rave omamo no tutir. Weramu are pirati po vatano kaijinta maponae ti wo ayao kakaije rave, opamo kakaije mo augav.

Muno are pirati po arikainy tuvano wanave Inaije inta aponae ti po ayao kakaije rave, opamo indati Amisye po parijo mangke raugaje ai. Weti kove mamo orame rapuisyo vatane wato ai amaugusyo no mayane rai indamu mansyan, weye wemirati mangke mamaun, yara mangke Amisye pare po raugaje ai manakoeve mo mangke umaso rakivan.

Weti wasyisyaube! Nya arakove inta po ayao kakaije inta rave, weamo nyo raura nanto kakavimbe ai nyare, ‘Vemo mbeare omai nora.’ Umba ranivara sakinavo apa ayao kakaije rai, weamo nyo aneme raijar indamu isanuga nsauman.

Muno ranivara nya arakova po ayao kakaije rave nai tutir ti nseo no susye kaururum, weamo vemo nyo apaya inya. Yara arono rui vayave pare sakinavo apa ayao kakaije rai, weamo nyo aneme raijar akato indamu isanuga nsauman.”
Amisy Yesus apa arakove wo raura Ai ware, “Injae, reamare Nyo reama anave ravera mbambunin.”

Umba Yesus po raura akananto mai pare, “Wapanave mamaun bayave kai, weamo mamaisy. Weye ranivara wapa anave mamaun maisyare sesawi kamijo momoyain dave ramaisy, weamo wapo inyoe wato raura nanto wapare, ‘Inyo moto winy, mpatin da nto ntemasyo no nawanano warave,’ weamo mamaisyo nya ana ndaura rai kobe.”
Ananeneae vatano panapatambe akarije inta ai

Yesus po ananeneae inta raura taiso pare, “Vatane inta panapatambe akarije inta ai, po mine rakaro no apa nawaisy muno po apa maero domba maeranande. Mare ngkaumu kobe vatano panapatambe umaso pakato no yavar, weramu animaisye mirati apa akarije po raura nanto ai? Apa akari apa ana po rave ai mi som: Po awainde inda paje tuna pisyisy wusyimbe ramu.
Yara pare, ‘Nyo sya anaisye ratayao! Nyanapatambe rinai indamu risyisyi dati! Umbawe winyamo nyisyisy akato rijabe.’
Akarije umaso po kove raura vatano panapatambe umaso aije ramu, yara pare, ‘Apa anakere mije, ti po rave kai.’

Weapamo wasaurata irati vatano panapatambe umawe ai. Arono wapo anakero Amisye po raugaje wasaije ravea mewen to, syare wasaemen weapamo Apa vatano wapanapatambe vayave nawirati weap. Vemo wasararin nora, weye anakero wapo rave mamo anakero Po wasatutiro rai to mije.”
Yesus po saumane raunanto vatano abusyino aravure mo mave mansai
Yesus apa unanui anya pare to no Yerusalem, weamo panya no munijo Samaria muno munijo Galilea aya anone rarijato.
Umba siso no munije inta rai, naije nanto vatano aravure mo mave inta mansai mansano abusyin. Usaiyo waravaimbe,
umba ugwain ware, “Yesus, Injayo Kuruno Winy, naemeno reansai!”
Arono Yesus po maen, po raura mai pare, “Wata wapo wasanasine rarorono syeno utantuna no Yavaro Amisye raije mai indamu mamaisyo Ananyao Musa rai.” Naije wanya kobe, umba manakea nsauman.
Vatane inta no no awa yasyin po anakea raen nsauman to, weti pakare anayanambe ti gwain pare, “Amisye ararimbe! Risauman to!”
Umba po vukane ranteter no Yesus amun, umba po kove raura nanto Ai. Vatane umaso pamo vatano Samaria pa.
Umba Yesus po raura akananto ai pare, “Vatano abusyine umawe manakea nsauman to, weramu umba vatano kaimambisye wenawi rui?
Veanimaibe vatano kaije umawe wakare wo Amisye ararimbe jewen, yara vatano marane so bo pi de po Amisye ararimbe?”
Umba Yesus po raura vatano Samaria umaso ai pare, “Nseo muno nyoronto. Nyanave Inai jivae, wirati winsaumanoe.”
Amisye apa be akarive Apa kawasae mai

Vatano Parisije inta wo Yesus anajo ware, “Nandui rati Amisye de be akarive mine vone so rai?” Yesus po raura akananto mai pare, “Amisye apa de be akarive Apa kawasae mai no mine vone somamo ana inta raroron kakavimbe indamu vatane wo raeno mansamije rai ma jewena.
Muno vemo vatane wo raura ware, ‘Waperade! Amisye de be akarive no naiso!’ indako ‘Waperato no ratuije!’, wenora. Weye tugae mamo Amisye apa be akarive no no Apa kawasae wapa yasyine so rai to.”
Arono munije ama akari

Umba Yesus po raura Apa arakovo utavondi aije mai pare, “Ama masyote nde nande arono wabeke dave wapare wapo masyoto Arikainyo Vatane syakare raije raen. Weramu indati wapo raene ramu weye Sya masyote umaso mamai dainya nene.
Arono naije vatane inta wo raura wasai ware, ‘Napi ratuije!’ dako, ‘Napi so!’ dako, weramu wabemo wata wapo inakani jinya.
Weye arono indati Risy, Arikainyo Vatane, syakare no mine vone so rai kobe, omamo maisyare muno ivake ratukande no ranijo wanamuram ndento no varet wemaisy. Weti vatan tenambe wo raen kobe.
Weramu manasyimbe indati siurijo manakoe nande Arikainyo Vatane rinai, muno vatano arono naiso wo inawatambe.
Arono Risy, Arikainyo Vatan, syakare rai, weamo mamaisyo wusyino arono Noakija no no mine vone so we ramaisy.

Arono naije vatane wo masyoto makanande ratantona ramu, yara manayanambe anaisye, ana ramaname bo rai tutir. Anya wo wanya maovan muno ajae wo awa arikainyo wanya awa vainye raokaisy. Maisyare omaisye miridije ntoa masyoto Noakija siso apa nyomane rai. Umba kavuratawe manayame njam mo mapupuji ti ukakai vintabo.
Maisyare omai tavon arono Lota no no mine vone so. Vatano munijo Sodom wisyisy, muno wanamavumbe, muno wo anareye rayanyum, muno wo yavare ranari janyi.
Maisyare omaisye miridije ntoa Lota puje no munijo Sodom raora, umba Amisye po tanamo mbadurur no no naumo warae raugaje mai, ti ukakai vintabo.
Maisyare omai tavon arono indati Risy, Arikainyo Vatan, ride papabe, Syo sya kovo ntiti raroron kakavimbe.

Arono indati masyoto namije nande, vatano tuna no apa yavare ama akiri muno apa ananuge ntuna no apa yavar uga, vemo de pakaiso dauga nora! Maisyare omai tavon, vatano to no no nawaisy uga, vemo sarirae pakare nora!
Syare wasaemen irati ana nande Lota pe apa anamu me yaije rai!
Are pirati beker pare po apa kovo mine so ramavug, opamo indati apave kovo nuge nuganui raije ramu. Yara are pirati akirive taune apa kovo mine vone so rai, opamo indati apave kovo nuge nuganui rai.
Syo raura wasai syare arono naije vatane jiruma nyakijo tanije intabo rai, umba Amisye po inta augav, yara inta pamo no kobe.
Wanya jiruma yo kasyambere kami ranumu, Amisye po inta raugav, yara inta mamo no.
Vatane jiruma yo nawaisye raijar, Amisye po inta augav, yara inta pamo no.”

Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije wo anajo ware, “Injae, ana umaso nande no munije rui?” Yesus po raura akananto mai pare, “Arono wapo insanijo koroe maeno wanugani, wapare, ‘Somaida maere ine inta ntuna no naije.’ Maisyare omai tavon, arono anakotaro Syo ratodi umawe nande tenambe, wapare, ‘Arikainyo Vatane pakare.’ ”
